title: NormDetect: Anchored Calibration for Low-False-Positive Detection of Machine-Generated Web Text
abstract: arXiv:2610.41459v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web platforms screen posts for text written by large language models, and every false flag hits a human writer. Detectors must therefore run at a very low false positive rate (FPR). Zero-shot detectors such as Binoculars score text with frozen language models, but invisible edits such as homoglyphs shatter tokenization and push machine text into the human range. Unicode normalization undoes these edits, yet the normalized score still misses half of the machine text at a strict FPR, under attacks that leave nothing to clean. We find that with the Falcon-7B scoring pair, heads on token statistics recall less than the normalized score at this FPR, and several flag too many human posts in some sections. We propose NormDetect, which anchors a learned per-section head to the normalized zero-shot score. A blend weight chosen on training folds under a human FPR cap combines the two scores, and one threshold is calibrated on human text only. On e

translated_title: NormDetect：面向机器生成网络文本低误报检测的锚定校准方法
translated_abstract: 网络平台需要筛查帖子中由大语言模型撰写的文本，而每一次误判都会伤害到一位真实的人类作者。因此，检测器必须在极低的误报率（FPR）下运行。诸如 Binoculars 这类零样本检测器使用冻结的语言模型对文本进行评分，但同形字符等不可见编辑会破坏分词过程，使机器文本的得分落入人类文本的区间。Unicode 规范化虽然可以消除这些编辑，但在严格的误报率下，规范化后的评分仍会漏掉一半的机器文本，尤其是在那些不留下任何可清洗痕迹的攻击下。我们发现，使用 Falcon-7B 评分对时，基于词元统计的检测头在该误报率下的召回率低于规范化评分，而且其中一些检测头在某些分区中会标记过多的人类帖子。我们提出 NormDetect，它将一个可学习的分区级检测头锚定到规范化的零样本评分上。在人类文本误报率上限的约束下，通过训练折选出的混合权重将两个评分结合起来，并且仅使用人类文本校准一个阈值。在 e……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: NormDetect 将可学习的分区级检测头锚定到规范化零样本评分上，并通过仅在人类文本上校准的单一阈值，实现了低误报率下对机器生成网络文本的稳健检测，即使面对破坏分词的不可见编辑攻击依然有效。
en_tdlr: NormDetect anchors a learned per-section head to the normalized zero-shot score and calibrates a single threshold on human text only, achieving robust low-false-positive detection of machine-generated web text even under tokenization-disrupting attacks.
